title: Three options are roughly enough - Variance-optimal semi-static hedging in the rough Heston model
abstract: arXiv:2610.13543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies semi-static variance-optimal hedging of variance swaps in the rough Heston model under a risk-neutral measure. We combine dynamic trading in the underlying asset with static positions in a finite basket of European options, with the aim of minimizing the variance of the residual hedging error. Exploiting the Markovian lift provided by the forward variance curve, the Fourier representations of the claims and the Laplace transform characterization of the log-price, we derive semi-explicit formulas for the optimal strategies and the hedging error. We then study the optimal claim selection problem, investigating numerically how the choice of static instruments depends on the Hurst index. translated_title: 三个期权大致就够了——粗糙Heston模型中的方差最优半静态对冲
translated_abstract: 本文研究在风险中性测度下粗糙Heston模型中方差互换的半静态方差最优对冲问题。我们将标的资产的动态交易与有限篮子欧式期权的静态头寸相结合，旨在最小化剩余对冲误差的方差。通过利用远期方差曲线所提供的马氏提升、未定权益的傅里叶表示以及对数价格的拉普拉斯变换刻画，我们推导出了最优策略和对冲误差的半显式公式。随后，我们研究了最优权益选择问题，通过数值方法考察静态工具的选择如何依赖于Hurst指数。在标准参数化下，我们发现“三个期权大致就够了”，即在所有考虑的粗糙度范围内，添加三个静态普通期权相较于纯动态对冲可将对冲误差降低95%以上。
tldr: 本文在粗糙Heston模型中推导出方差互换半静态方差最优对冲的半显式最优策略公式，并通过数值研究发现只需添加三个静态普通期权即可将对冲误差较纯动态对冲降低95%以上。
en_tdlr: This paper derives semi-explicit formulas for variance-optimal semi-static hedging of variance swaps in the rough Heston model and shows numerically that adding just three static vanilla options reduces the hedging error by more than 95% compared to purely dynamic hedging.
